project.title: Office 365 and Microsoft Azure Cloud Service Delivery Manager

parentsummary.deliverables: Provided governance, oversight, and advisory services for Brookfield Renewable Energy's Azure and Office 365 cloud environments during a complex MSP vendor consolidation, overseeing the SoftChoice support vendor's cloud architecture, governing the Azure AD and Office 365 access control posture, managing the Microsoft Intune mobile security program rollout, and maintaining day-to-day operational service continuity.
parentsummary.outcomes: Successfully governed cloud service continuity and vendor transition during a period of significant M&A-driven organizational change, delivering consistent KPI-measured performance, a secured Azure AD and O365 access posture, and a successfully rolled-out mobile security program via Microsoft Intune.

challenge.summary: The client was performing extensive internal change, due to growth via Mergers & Acquisition, requiring a change in support vendor. A consolidation of multiple Managed Service Providers was in flight. The primary objective was to provide guidance and governance to the cloud services (Azure and Office365) support vendor, SoftChoice.

deliverables: Provide guidance and governance to the cloud services (Azure and Office365)
Provide management and oversight of vendor cloud architecture
Oversight and governance for implementation of IT Security to meet NIST controls (eq. ITSG)
Governed the Azure AD and Office 365 access control posture during MSP vendor consolidation
Provided guidance and governance to Mobile Security Program and Posture to manage roll-out of Microsoft Azure InTune
Coordinated transition requirements across Brookfield Renewable Energy business departments and SoftChoice support teams
Oversaw workload and workflow migration to Office365, and Azure Cloud
Responsible for performance monitoring via standardized KPIs
Provided knowledge transfer and training to internal FTE staff
Day-to-day management of internal requests and tickets, including Active Directory, on-premise E-mail, and Cisco CUCM

outcomes: ✅ Provide guidance and governance to the cloud services (Azure and Office365)
✅ Provide management and oversight of vendor cloud architecture
✅ Oversight and governance for implementation of IT Security to meet NIST controls (eq. ITSG)
